lines.say: It's 1 a.m. and you're still scrolling.
lines.query: woman scrolling phone in bed at night

lines.say: One: charge it outside the bedroom.
Two: same cutoff every night. Use Bedtime mode.
Three: switch to grayscale. Grey feeds are boring.
lines.query: scrolling social media phone close up

lines.say: Four: if willpower fails, lock it in a timed box.
